verdict.rationale: Together's docs state that an OpenAI-client setup can target Together-hosted models by changing only the API key and base URL. That is the core of switching providers without provider-specific code. Function calling, structured outputs and SSE streaming are documented, but the evidence does not explicitly tie them to OpenAI-format parity. Missing for 10: detailed compatibility docs showing which chat-completions parameters (tools, response_format, streaming) behave identically, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a drop-in provider swap.
